Text.WarriorsDes: 战士是一种拥有极大力量和耐力的职业。他们在战斗中不易被杀死，并且擅长使用多种重型武器和护甲。因此，战士偏好基于近战物理伤害的攻击。他们在远程攻击方面较弱，但为战士专门开发的多种装备弥补了他们在远程战斗中的弱点。
Text.WizardDes: 法师是一种力量和耐力较低的职业，但拥有使用强大法术的能力。他们的攻击性法术非常有效，但由于施放这些法术需要时间，他们往往容易暴露在敌人的攻击之下。因此，身体较弱的法师必须从安全距离攻击敌人。
Text.TaoistDes: 道士在天文、医术以及除武功之外的其他领域上都有严格修炼。他们的特长不在于直接与敌人交战，而是通过辅助来支持盟友。道士能够召唤强大的生物，并且具有很高的魔法抗性，是攻防能力均衡的职业。
Text.AssassinDes: 刺客是秘密组织的成员，他们的历史较为神秘。他们能够隐藏自身并在不被他人察觉的情况下发动攻击，这天生让他们擅长快速击杀目标。由于生命力和力量较弱，他们必须避免与多个敌人作战。
Text.ArcherDes: 弓箭手是精准度和力量都很高的职业，利用弓箭的强大技能可以在远距离造成惊人的伤害。与法师类似，他们依靠敏锐的直觉来躲避来袭攻击，因为正面攻击容易让他们暴露。然而，他们强大的体能和致命的准度使得被命中的目标心生畏惧。

Text.WarriorsDescription: 战士是力量和生命力极为强大的职业。他们在战斗中不易被击杀，并且能够使用各种重型武器和盔甲。因此，战士擅长近身物理伤害攻击。虽然在远程攻击方面较弱，但为战士专门打造的多样装备正好弥补了他们在远程战斗中的不足。
Text.WizardsDescription: 法师的力量和耐力较低，但能使用强大的法术。他们的攻击性法术非常有效，但因为施法需要时间，容易在此期间暴露于敌人的攻击之下。因此，实力较弱的法师必须保持安全距离来攻击敌人。
Text.TaoistsDescription: 道士精通天文、医术等多种学问，除武功外也颇有造诣。他们通常不直接与敌人交战，而是以辅助队友为特长。道士可以召唤强大的生物，并且拥有很高的魔法抗性，是攻防均衡的职业。
Text.AssassinsDescription: 刺客属于神秘组织，其历史鲜为人知。他们能在不被察觉的情况下隐藏自己并发动攻击，擅长迅速击杀目标。由于生命力和力量较弱，刺客必须避免与多个敌人正面交战。
Text.ArchersDescription: 弓箭手拥有极高的精准度与力量，擅长使用弓类技能从远距离造成致命伤害。与法师相似，他们依靠敏锐的直觉来闪避袭来的攻击，因为他们在正面战中容易暴露。然而，弓箭手的强大体能与致命的瞄准让任何被击中的敌人心生畏惧。

Text.ModernWinHelpWelcomeSum: Pick a topic on the left, search above, or start with the basics below. ← → turn the pages of a topic.
Text.ModernWinHelpShortcutsSum: Every key the game listens to, read from your current key bindings.
Text.ModernWinHelpChatSum: Prefixes that send a message to a whisper, your group, your guild or everyone nearby, and @commands.
Text.ModernWinHelpMovementsSum: Left-click the ground to walk, right-click to run; hold the button to keep moving.
Text.ModernWinHelpAttackingSum: Click a monster to attack it. Hold Shift to attack on the spot without stepping.
Text.ModernWinHelpCollectingSum: Stand on an item and press {0} to pick it up; it goes into your bag.
Text.ModernWinHelpHealthSum: The red bar is your HP. Drink potions from the belt ({0} to {1}) before it runs out.
Text.ModernWinHelpSkillsSum: Learn skills from books, put them on the skill bar ({0} to {1}) and train them by using them.
Text.ModernWinHelpManaSum: The blue bar is your MP. Spells cost it; it comes back over time and with potions.
Text.ModernWinHelpStatisticsSum: What AC, MAC, DC, MC, SC, Accuracy, Agility and the rest do for you.
Text.ModernWinHelpChattingSum: Type in the chat box and press Enter. Prefixes pick who hears it.
Text.ModernWinHelpGroupsSum: Invite players with the group window; members nearby share EXP.
Text.ModernWinHelpTradingSum: Face a player and press {0} to ask for a trade; nothing moves until both of you confirm.
Text.ModernWinHelpInspectingSum: Ctrl + right-click a player to see what they are wearing.
Text.ModernWinHelpPurchasingSum: Speak to a merchant NPC and pick Buy to see what they sell.
Text.ModernWinHelpSellingSum: Speak to a merchant NPC to sell items; each merchant deals in its own kind of goods.
Text.ModernWinHelpRepairingSum: Speak to a merchant NPC to repair worn gear for gold; special repair keeps the maximum durability.
Text.ModernWinHelpDurabilitySum: Gear wears down as you fight. At zero it stops working until it is repaired.
Text.ModernWinHelpGemsSum: Put a gem or orb on an item to add to its stats. It can fail.
Text.ModernWinHelpAwakeningSum: Raise an item past its normal limits with materials, at the awakening NPC.
Text.ModernWinHelpQuestsSum: NPCs with quests show a mark over their head. Track up to five on screen.
Text.ModernWinHelpMountsSum: Equip a mount and press {0} to ride. Keep its loyalty up and fit it with gear.
Text.ModernWinHelpFishingSum: With a rod, face the water and cast; reel in when the float dips.
Text.ModernWinHelpHeroesSum: A companion who fights beside you, with its own gear, bag, skills and behaviour.
Text.ModernWinHelpGuildBuffsSum: Guilds spend buff points to give every member a boost.
Text.ModernWinHelpTip1: Hold Shift while you attack to stay on the spot instead of walking into the monster.
Text.ModernWinHelpTip2: Ctrl + right-click a player to inspect their equipment.
Text.ModernWinHelpTip3: Start a chat line with !! to talk to your group, or !~ for your guild.
Text.ModernWinHelpTip4: Put potions on the belt ({0} to {1}) so you can drink them without opening your bag.
Text.ModernWinHelpTip5: Merchants only buy the kind of goods they sell.
Text.ModernWinHelpTip6: A special repair costs more but keeps your item's maximum durability.
Text.ModernWinHelpTip7: {0} to {1} use the second skill bar.
Text.ModernWinHelpTip8: Track up to five quests at once; their objectives show on the right of the screen.

Text.ModernNpcRepairBagOnly: Worn gear is repaired only from your bag
Text.ModernNpcRepairExplain: A normal repair restores durability but takes a thirtieth of what was missing off the maximum.
Text.ModernNpcRepairOneByOne: Repair items one at a time, or bring more gold
Text.ModernNpcRepairTitle: Repair · each repair wears the maximum down a little
Text.ModernNpcResetKeeps: The item keeps its base stats, sockets, awakening and seal.
Text.ModernNpcRingPrice: The new ring is worn on your left hand. Price: the new ring's level ({0}) x 10 x {1} gold.
Text.ModernNpcSRepairExplain: Special repair costs three times the price and keeps the maximum durability. Some items can't be special repaired.
Text.ModernNpcSRepairTitle: Special repair · the maximum is kept, three times the price
Text.ModernNpcSeeChat: See the chat for the server's answer.
Text.ModernNpcSelectJunkHint: Pick outgrown Common gear (15+ levels under yours, no added stats) and candles
Text.ModernNpcSellCaption: Your bag · the merchant pays half the price
Text.ModernNpcSellHint: Click items to pick them for sale. Picks are sold together in one go. Alt + click in the bag sells at once.
Text.ModernNpcTabOffHint: Opens the merchant's page for this
Text.ModernNpcTabSpeakTo: Speak to {0} and choose {1} on the page.
Text.ModernNpcOpenLinkAsk: Open a web page on {0} in your browser?
